run_render_single_frame: run mjwarp-render to render a single RGB and depth image from an MJCF model
run_render_rollout_video: run mjwarp-render to render a rollout GIF video from a simulation with multiple steps
run_render_tiled_grid: run mjwarp-render to render a 4x4 tiled grid of RGB and depth images across 16 parallel worlds
run_render_with_model_override: run mjwarp-render with model overrides to modify MJCF parameters before rendering
run_render_with_custom_camera: run mjwarp-render with a custom camera index, resolution, and output paths for RGB and depth images
